segments.name: Vehicle Propulsion Solutions
segments.description: Manufactures and distributes fully automatic transmissions and propulsion solutions for commercial, off-highway and defense vehicles, plus service parts.
segments.evidence: The Company was in one line of business, which was the manufacture and distribution of vehicle propulsion solutions.

revenueModel.text: Allison is paid primarily by OEMs under long-term agreements, and by distributors, dealers and end users for propulsion solutions, replacement parts and support equipment.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell substantially all of our propulsion solutions in the North American on-highway market to OEMs.
